issue_description: The uploaded batch contains six Swiggy quarterly letters only; no Eternal shareholder letters are present.
audit_trail: Impact: FoodIQ cannot yet compute Eternal-versus-Swiggy competitive gaps, cross-company leading indicators or peer-relative conclusions. | Required Action: Keep company=Eternal absent/null; build schema to support it but never generate proxy values. Upload matched Eternal letters for same quarters.

issue_description: Q1FY27 Platform MTU differs: Q1FY27 letter page 5 reports 27.5m, while Q2FY27 historical chart page 5 displays 26.2m.
audit_trail: Impact: Changes growth calculations / historical trend. No explanatory restatement note identified on the KPI page. | Required Action: Store separate document-specific observations; flag possible restatement or error; chart latest-reported series with conflict annotation and maintain as-published series.

issue_description: Historical platform frequency differs across letters: Q1FY26 4.18 in Q1FY26 letter vs 4.13 in Q1FY27 historical chart; Q1FY27 3.87 in Q1FY27 letter vs 3.92 in Q2FY27 historical chart.
audit_trail: Impact: Historical trend / cohort comparisons change. | Required Action: Preserve each published observation with report date; do not silently overwrite.

issue_description: Swiggy management explicitly says Food Delivery NOV is not published because discounts are not structurally comparable; use Food GOV.
audit_trail: Impact: The project specification originally proposed NOV normalisation for Food. A Food NOV field would be unsupported. | Required Action: Make GOV the core Food comparison metric; keep NOV blank. Capture statement and page.

issue_description: Swiggy management also states it does not publish Out-of-Home NOV for similar structural comparability reasons.
audit_trail: Impact: Cannot make OOH NOV-based analysis from this source pack. | Required Action: Use OOH GOV; do not infer NOV.

issue_description: The user seed-data uses segment=Consolidated and GOV values that are B2C GOV, while adjusted revenue/EBITDA are consolidated metrics.
audit_trail: Impact: Different scopes are mixed within one row; misleading ratios can result. | Required Action: Separate B2C GOV, B2C adjusted revenue, consolidated adjusted revenue, consolidated adjusted EBITDA and Platform Innovations.

issue_description: Margin denominators differ by segment: Food/QuickCommerce/OOH contribution and adjusted EBITDA margins are generally as % GOV; Supply Chain EBITDA margin is % revenue; Platform Innovations margin is % adjusted revenue; Platform B2C margin is % B2C GOV.
audit_trail: Impact: Invalid peer or segment comparisons if margins are treated as one common ratio. | Required Action: Store denominator in each metric observation and metric definition; never compare without matched basis.

issue_description: Seed absolute QuickCommerce NOV series appears partly inferred from NOV/GOV ratios and partly explicitly reported. Q1FY27 and Q2FY27 source ratios are rounded to whole percentages while absolute values do not equal exact multiplication.
audit_trail: Impact: A derived approximation can be mistaken for a company-reported absolute metric. | Required Action: Keep seed values in a separate user-submitted series, add source_status, and confirm each quarter from text or table before promotion to reported status.

issue_description: Q2FY27 source discusses nAOV ₹506 while KPI chart reports AOV ₹708; Q1FY27 source discusses nAOV ₹508 while chart AOV is ₹691. No complete definition of nAOV was located in glossary.
audit_trail: Impact: Substituting nAOV for AOV would create a false trend / mismatch with orders and GOV. | Required Action: Retain separate metrics aov_inr and naov_inr; capture exact definition if found; do not substitute.

issue_description: QComm monthly contribution break-even was achieved in May 2026, but Q1FY27 quarterly average was -0.2% and Q2FY27 quarterly average was -1.0%.
audit_trail: Impact: A simple “break-even achieved” label would misrepresent the run-rate and reinvestment dynamics. | Required Action: Store milestone date/value, quarterly averages and subsequent margin investment explanation separately.

issue_description: Lynks stake sale disclosed in Q2FY27; Lynks segment results cease being included from Q3FY27 and management expects ~₹20cr segment EBITDA benefit.
audit_trail: Impact: Supply Chain / Distribution segment trend has structural discontinuity. | Required Action: Add corporate-action structural-break event; normalise historical comparison or disclose perimeter difference.

issue_description: The spec assumes take_rate_pct = adjusted revenue / NOV. Source management take-rate references (Food 25.8% / 26.1%, QuickComm 14.8%) do not have a complete consistent formula established in the supplied definitions.
audit_trail: Impact: Derived take rates could be wrong or not comparable. | Required Action: Use source-reported take-rate series only where explicit; do not calculate from guessed numerator/denominator. Add definition and source reference.

issue_description: The original spec proposes a contribution margin bridge using delta take-rate + volume leverage + residual cost. This does not mathematically reconcile without component-level disclosed revenue/cost amounts and correct denominators.
audit_trail: Impact: Could create pseudo-precision / double-counting. | Required Action: Build a monetary CM = CM% × GOV series; produce attribution only where actual driver components reconcile to the total change. Treat management bps bridge separately as management attribution.

issue_description: AOV lead correlation with ~8–10 quarterly observations cannot establish causal prediction.
audit_trail: Impact: Interview claim may overstate statistical evidence. | Required Action: Call it exploratory lead/lag association; compare lag 0/1/2, level and first-difference series, confidence interval, p value, sample size and common-trend caveats.

issue_description: The user seed labels certain guidance as met/missed based on one observation and treats ongoing medium-term goals alike.
audit_trail: Impact: Management scorecard may falsely label long-term ambitions as missed. | Required Action: Classify each item as formal annual guidance, near-term guidance, scale threshold, medium-term ambition, long-term aspiration, or qualitative strategy. Use pending / achieved milestone / in-range / approximately met with evidence.

issue_description: Quarterly orders per store/day are based on active darkstore-days; store count at quarter-end is not the same denominator.
audit_trail: Impact: Recalculated productivity from total orders / closing store count will be inaccurate. | Required Action: Use published orders/store/day directly or reconstruct from active store-days if available; document denominator.

issue_description: Q1 food metrics are seasonally affected by monsoon, delivery partner availability, reverse migration and salary cycle; Q2/Q3 have festive season effects.
audit_trail: Impact: Simple QoQ movement may be seasonal rather than structural. | Required Action: Prefer YoY comparisons and seasonal annotations; where enough data exists, include seasonal controls.

issue_description: Several metrics like GOV/sqft, estimated order productivity and annualised run-rate are not equivalent to audited revenue or profitability.
audit_trail: Impact: Mixing operational ratios with reported financial statements reduces credibility. | Required Action: Tag every value as reported / derived / management estimate / user-provided / model assumption.

issue_description: Seed data currently ends at Q1FY27, while Q2FY27 letter is uploaded and includes an additional quarter.
audit_trail: Impact: Dataset is stale relative to supplied source pack. | Required Action: Add Q2FY27 rows from Q2FY27 KPI charts and use source-specific page references.

issue_description: Company page-16 cash reconciliation balance is not necessarily identical to statutory “cash and cash equivalents” balance-sheet line.
audit_trail: Impact: Potential inconsistent liquidity comparisons. | Required Action: Preserve line-item label and source context; never merge the two cash concepts.
